image_title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: The visual consists of two tables and a figure illustrating the performance of various models in the context of test-time reinforcement learning (TRL). Table 1 presents main results across different models, highlighting the performance metrics such as AIMEE 2024, AMC, and MATH-500, with a focus on the relative improvement of TRL over baseline models. Table 2 breaks down the performance on the MATH-500 dataset by difficulty level, showing the percentage of improvement for each level. The figure further emphasizes the relative gain in performance when using TRL compared to the baseline, particularly noting that math-specialized models benefit significantly from tool verification, especially on harder benchmarks. Key insights include the observation that the hardest difficulty level (L5) shows the largest gains, indicating that tool execution enhances verification reliability on challenging tasks.
